boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the Main Street and North Country Road corridors in Stony Brook Village.

cards.title: Village Green and crescent plan
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, Stony Brook Village
cards.notes: Walk the Village Green and follow the crescent-shaped storefront layout; use the center directory to choose a stop before you go.
cards.short_summary: A named village-center destination organized around its green and connected shops.
cards.evidence_claim: The official attractions page identifies Stony Brook Village Center at 111 Main Street and describes its village green and crescent-shaped design.
cards.access_notes: Use the Village Center map and directory for current tenant details.

cards.entity_name: Stony Brook Post Office Mechanical Eagle
cards.title: Watch the Mechanical Eagle
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, Stony Brook Village
cards.notes: Look up at the post office pediment near the hour to see the hand-carved Mechanical Eagle flap its wings.
cards.short_summary: A visible mechanical eagle mounted above the Stony Brook Post Office.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook Village states that the Mechanical Eagle at the 129 Main Street post office flaps its wings hourly from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The cited page gives the stated daily operating window; timing is described as almost on the hour.

cards.title: A Main Street landmark stop
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, Stony Brook Village
cards.notes: Use the Village Center attractions listing to locate this named Main Street church while walking the harbor-side village area.
cards.short_summary: A named church listed among Stony Brook Village attractions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stony Brook Village attractions page lists All Souls Episcopal Church on Main Street in Stony Brook.
cards.access_notes: Confirm service or visitor access directly with the church before entering.

cards.title: See the 1751 inn building
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, Stony Brook Village
cards.notes: Pause across from the Village Center to view the historic inn building, then check the current site for any visitor services.
cards.short_summary: A named historic inn on the Main Street side of the village.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook Village lists the Three Village Inn at 150 Main Street and states that the colonial inn was built in 1751.
cards.source_title: Where To Eat — Stony Brook Village
cards.access_notes: Dining and lodging services may require a purchase or reservation.

cards.title: Browse a jazz archive venue
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, beside Three Village Inn
cards.notes: Check the venue calendar before visiting, then allow time to see its displayed instruments, papers, photographs, and performance space.
cards.short_summary: A named Stony Brook music venue with archival materials and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook Village describes The Jazz Loft as a venue with jazz archives, displayed instruments and documents, performances, and classes.
cards.access_notes: Check the venue directly for exhibition and performance availability.

cards.title: Choose an art or history gallery
cards.subtitle: North Country Road (Route 25A) corridor, Stony Brook
cards.notes: Review current exhibitions before the trip and pick a gallery focus, such as regional art, history, or the carriage collection.
cards.short_summary: A Stony Brook museum devoted to Long Island art, history, and horse-drawn vehicles.
cards.evidence_claim: The Long Island Museum says it is located at 1200 Route 25A in Stony Brook and connects visitors with regional art, history, and its carriage collection.
cards.source_title: About the Museum — The Long Island Museum
cards.access_notes: Review the museum’s current hours and admission information before arrival.

cards.title: Follow a scheduled house tour
cards.subtitle: North Country Road corridor, Stony Brook
cards.notes: Watch for the museum’s announced tour dates and prepare for uneven historic surfaces, steps, and limited mobility access.
cards.short_summary: A circa-1725 historic house associated with painter William Sidney Mount.
cards.evidence_claim: The Long Island Museum identifies Hawkins-Mount House as a circa-1725 Stony Brook home on a historically significant section of North Country Road.
cards.source_title: Hawkins-Mount House Tours — The Long Island Museum
cards.access_notes: Tours occur only on announced dates; the cited page warns of uneven ground, flooring, and steps.

cards.entity_name: Stony Brook Harbor Kayak & Paddleboard Rentals
cards.title: Rent for a harbor outing
cards.subtitle: Shore Road, beside the Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Contact the operator for current pricing and conditions, and ask for novice instruction if this is your first time on the water.
cards.short_summary: A named water-rental destination at 51 Shore Road across from Three Village Inn.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook Village lists Stony Brook Harbor Kayak & Paddleboard Rentals at 51 Shore Road and states that novice instruction is provided.
cards.access_notes: Contact the operator for current conditions, instruction, availability, and pricing.

cards.title: Compare oils and vinegars
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, Stony Brook Village
cards.notes: Use the shop’s stated tasting option to compare products, then confirm current stock or hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A named specialty-food shop at 133 Main Street with oils, vinegars, and pantry goods.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook Village lists The Crushed Olive at 133 Main Street and says it offers olive oils, balsamic vinegar, and daily tastings.
cards.source_title: Where To Shop — Stony Brook Village
cards.access_notes: The official directory lists current operating hours; purchases are optional.

cards.title: Plan a stargazing workshop
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor, Stony Brook Village
cards.notes: Check the shop’s current workshop schedule and bring a specific camera or telescope question for a focused visit.
cards.short_summary: A named camera and telescope store at 85 Main Street that lists astronomy workshops.
cards.evidence_claim: Stony Brook Village lists Camera Concepts & Telescope Solutions at 85 Main Street and identifies cameras, telescopes, stargazing workshops, and photo prints.
cards.source_title: Where To Shop — Stony Brook Village
cards.access_notes: Confirm workshop dates and any participation costs directly with the business.
